By the authority vested in me as President by the Constitution and the statutes 
of the United States of A m erica, including the D epartm ent of Education 
Organization A ct (P.L. 96-88; 93 Stat. 668), it is hereby ordered as follow s:
1-101. Sunday, M ay 4, 1980, shall, for the purposes of Section 601 of the 
D epartm ent of Education O rganization A ct (20 U.S.C. 3401 note), be the date 
on w hich the provisions of that A ct shall take effect.
1-102. The D irector o f the O ffice of M anagem ent and Budget shall take all 
actions necessary or appropriate to effectuate the transfers provided for in the 
Departm ent of Education O rganization A ct, including the transfer of funds, 
records, property, personnel and positions.
1-103. A s required by Section 601 of the Departm ent of Education O rganiza­
tion Act, this Order shall be published in the Federal Register.
